new_value: Drop IDs now drawn from the OS CSPRNG via getrandom 0.2 (3 bytes -> 6 lowercase hex, format per spec 18.9 example; collision-retry kept). This mirrors the Python reference's secrets.token_hex(3) (python/src/lichen/coap/resources/deaddrop.py:41-43), replacing the splitmix64(now ^ counter) scheme that leaked entropy from an enumerable 24-bit space; the now-dead id_counter field was removed. 6-hex format and generate-on-collision semantics preserved, so vectors pinning format stay honest. New test generated_drop_ids_are_canonical_and_unique (16 add_drops: canonical format + uniqueness, deterministic since the store rejects duplicate IDs). Note: enumeration-rate-limiting of GET /deaddrop/{id} was 'considered' per the bead but deferred — bead oan4 handles the loop bound; miss-counting against the limiter remains open as a policy choice. Verified: cargo test -p lichen-client --lib 130 passed, deaddrop_vectors 24 passed (22 baseline + 2 new). Cargo.lock staged as a single-line hunk (getrandom 0.2.17 dep edge for lichen-client; version already in lock). Commit 9da8dd3503.
